nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner stored in Owned.owner
Pending owner address in Owned.newOwner used for two-step ownership transfer
Token symbol string, set to MTW in the MtTaborToken constructor
Token name string, set to 'Mt Tabor Wolves' in the constructor
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor
Cached total token supply _totalSupply minted to the deployer-designated address
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances; read and written by transfer/transferFrom
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances
Owned() constructor assigning msg.sender as the initial owner
transferOwnership(address) in Owned, guarded by onlyOwner, sets newOwner
acceptOwnership() finalizing ownership transfer after checking msg.sender == newOwner
MtTaborToken() constructor initializing metadata, _totalSupply and the initial balance
totalSupply() constant returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address) constant returning balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address,uint) moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address,uint) writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check
transferFrom(address,address,uint) performing allowance-based transfer with safeSub/safeAdd
allowance(address,address) constant returning the remaining allowance
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) approving then invoking the spender contract callback
Payable fallback function that always reverts so the contract rejects ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) onlyOwner function performing an arbitrary external token transfer
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint) with overflow require check
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint) with underflow require check
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint) with overflow require check
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint) with zero-divisor require check
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executing attacker-controlled code after state update
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, unvalidated token address
Balance subtraction in transfer (safeSub) whose checked result is written back into balances
Balance and allowance subtraction in transferFrom (safeSub) written back into balances and allowed
Parameter 'to' of transfer, the recipient address
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer, the amount moved
Parameter 'spender' of approve, the allowance beneficiary
Parameter 'tokens' of approve, the allowance amount
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, the debited account
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, the credited account
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, the amount moved
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance
Parameter 'spender' of allowance
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token, unvalidated external contract address
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token, amount rescued
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall, the contract that is called back
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall, the approved amount
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall, arbitrary bytes forwarded to the callback
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership, the proposed new owner
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf, the account queried
Local result variable c = a + b in safeAdd, checked with require(c >= a)
Local result variable c = a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a)

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the contract owner in the Owned constructor
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping when spending tokens
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping for approvals and allowance spending
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership gate-checks msg.sender against owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership
onlyOwner modifier gate-checks msg.sender before the arbitrary token rescue transfer
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument into the external receiveApproval callback
owner is used as the recipient address of the rescued tokens in transferAnyERC20Token
constructor assigns the fixed initial value to _totalSupply
constructor credits the whole supply into the balances mapping
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the total
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner
transfer reads and rewrites balances of msg.sender and the recipient
transferFrom reads and rewrites balances of 'from' and 'to'
approve overwrites the caller's allowance entry in allowed
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender] by the spent amount
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall writes the allowance before invoking the external callback
transfer delegates balance subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub
transfer delegates balance addition to SafeMath.safeAdd
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub
transferFrom delegates recipient balance addition to SafeMath.safeAdd

control returns from the untrusted receiveApproval call back into approveAndCall before it returns true

the boolean returned by the external token transfer is propagated as the function result
transfer executes the checked balance subtraction expressed by unsafe_safeSub_transfer
the result of the transfer subtraction is written back into the balances mapping
transferFrom executes the checked balance/allowance subtraction expressed by unsafe_safeSub_transferFrom
the transferFrom subtraction results are written back into balances and allowed
transferOwnership stores the proposed address into newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the transfer
_newOwner parameter is passed into transferOwnership as the argument
_newOwner parameter is assigned to the privileged newOwner state variable

'spender' parameter keys the inner mapping of allowed in approve
'tokens' parameter is stored as the new allowance value in approve
'from' parameter is the debited key in balances during transferFrom
'to' parameter is the credited key in balances during transferFrom
'tokens' parameter is the operand of the transferFrom subtraction/unsafe operation

'spender' parameter keys the inner mapping of allowed in allowance

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to key the balances mapping written by transfer; it should be folded into the transfer function node.
The 'tokens' amount is the direct operand of the balance subtraction unsafe operation inside transfer.
The 'spender' parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside approve.
The 'tokens' parameter is only stored as the allowance value by approve.
The 'from' parameter only identifies the debited balance entry handled by transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter only identifies the credited balance entry handled by transferFrom.
The 'tokens' amount is the direct operand of the balance/allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping in the view function.
The 'spender' parameter is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping in the view function.
The unvalidated 'tokenAddress' parameter is cast to ERC20Interface and called directly by the unsafe external call.
The 'tokens' parameter is passed as the amount of the unsafe external token transfer call.
The 'spender' parameter is the target contract of the receiveApproval callback unsafe operation.
The 'tokens' parameter is forwarded into the receiveApproval callback unsafe operation.
The 'data' parameter is forwarded as raw calldata into the receiveApproval callback unsafe operation.
The '_newOwner' parameter is only stored into the privileged newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only a lookup key for the balances mapping in the view function.
The local result c is the checked sum returned by safeAdd and is meaningless outside that function.
The local result c is the checked difference returned by safeSub and is meaningless outside that function.
